newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Geneva air cargo traffic down 4.7 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Geneva air cargo traffic down 4.7 pct in Sept.

text.p: Geneva's Cointrin airport handled 4,851 tonnes of air cargo traffic in August, a decrease of 4.7 percent on the same month in 1995, airport authority figures show.
January-August 1996 air cargo throughput at Geneva totalled 42,708 tonnes, down 6.3 percent on 1995 levels.

August 1996 postal traffic handled at the airport increased by 1.6 percent on the same month last year to 631 tonnes while January-August volume fell by 0.6 percent on the first eight months of 1995 to 5,731 tonnes. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
